P4.critique: num_turns=9, 6 Bash + 1 Write + 1 Edit, 70.2 s, $0.416. Verification was batched -- spec JSON write, spec_consistency and the geometry gate went out as a single Bash call with an '=== GATE ===' separator. Two rediscovery detour clusters: (1) the FreeCAD 0.21.2 API (`AttachmentSupport` does not exist on this version) cost 1 turn and was fixed with a defensive `hasattr` fallback to `.Support` rather than a blind retry -- good; (2) pip/PYTHONPATH fumbling cost 3 turns (pip --user, cd /tmp && pip --user, then `PYTHONPATH= pip install --user`). Two clusters / 4 wasted turns is within the '~3 detours' allowance, but the pip cluster alone is a third of the session. No GUI, no interactive waits.

notes: Second-cleanest run. The one thing worth carrying forward is the API-version detour: `AttachmentSupport` is FreeCAD 1.x, the image ships 0.21.2 where the property is `.Support`. Two of the four trials hit this exact wall independently (this one and NvuQimn) and each paid 1-2 turns for it. It is a per-task tax that a single line in the task prompt would erase. The agent's own fix -- `hasattr` probe with fallback -- is the right shape for a durable snippet.
